name: marrow/ui
description: A ready-to-use Tailwind + Alpine.js component library for Marrow — 30+ components (Button, Card, Select, Breadcrumb, a Form bridge to marrow/form-builder, and more) built on the framework's existing Component/ComponentRegistry primitives.

suggest.marrow/form-builder: Enables the `form` component's automatic field rendering for a marrow/form-builder Form instance
